findings: SystemUI factory supports ai_pets and AiPetsTemplateView binds custom resourcePag from persisted template data
SystemUI observes current_tiny_keyguard_info and all_tiny_keyguard_info; native template data is shared with AOD editor
AiPetsTemplateView initial binding requests no autoplay; parent wake path can play, subject to notifications and biometric unlock
Single-click can replay; AOD touch path returns without handling click; fold path hides PAG layer
AiPetsTemplateView uses explicit wallpaper position translations when both orientations exist; otherwise first-frame axes fallback
AOD apply source copies resources before current selection write; optional history insertion follows; history list may be truncated
rollbackAiPetsByBizId filters history and may select first remaining item; it is not exact transaction restoration
Native backup delegate handles both secure settings and resource archives but is internal FullBackupAgent plumbing, not a verified public rollback API
